entries.source:
#{bold}#
Here rests Weldeth the Deserter
#{normal}#86 - 103#{italic}#
Fled from battle
Bereft of pride
On a comrade's sword
He quickly died
#{normal}#
entries.target:
#{bold}#
这里长眠着逃兵韦德斯
#{normal}#86 - 103#{italic}#
逃离战场
尊严尽丧
不久便死在
同袍剑下
#{normal}#

entries.source:
We have heard rumours from the Dwarves that there may still be an orc presence deep in the old kingdom of Reknor, in the Iron Throne.
I know you have been through a lot, but we need somebody to investigate and determine if there is a connection with the staff.
entries.target:
我们从矮人那里听到传闻，在钢铁王座境内的瑞库纳古王国深处可能仍有兽人出没。
我知道你历经艰险，但我们需要有人前去调查，查明这是否与那根法杖有关。

entries.source: Psi when firing a critical mind attack:
entries.target: 精神暴击时回复灵能值：

entries.source:
You rage coalesces at a single point, and then explodes outward, blasting enemies within a radius of %d in all directions. The blast causes %d damage and %d knockback at the center, that decreases with distance. Anyone caught in the explosion will also be dazed for 3 turns.
		In addition, your ability to channel force with this talent increases all critical damage by %d%% (currently: %d%%)
		Damage increases with your Mindpower.
entries.target:
你的愤怒汇聚于一点，随后向外爆发，轰击半径 %d 格内四面八方的敌人。爆炸中心造成 %d 点伤害并击退 %d 格，伤害和击退距离随离爆心的距离增加而降低。爆炸范围内的所有生物还会被眩晕 3 回合。
		此外，通过此技能引导力量的能力会使你的所有暴击伤害提高 %d%%（当前：%d%%）。
		伤害随你的精神强度提高。

entries.source: A gargantuan bone giant resembling a wingless wyrm. He is fully sentient and surprisingly fast.
entries.target: 一只巨大的骨巨人，形似无翼巨龙。他完全具有自我意识，而且快得惊人。

entries.source: The target is terrified taking %d mind and darkness damage per turn and increasing all their cooldowns by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标陷入惊恐，每回合受到 %d 点精神和暗影伤害，所有冷却时间增加 %d%%。

entries.source: Granted talent can block up to 1 instance of damage each 10 turns.
entries.target: 提供技能：每十回合能抵挡一次攻击。
关于那件独一无二的物品呢？

entries.source: I shall accept your offer, my liege.
entries.target: 我接受你的提议，领主大人。

entries.source: #YELLOW_GREEN#An ironic harmony surrounds Ureslak's remains as they reunite.
entries.target: #YELLOW_GREEN#乌尔斯拉克的遗物重聚时，一种讽刺的和谐笼罩四周。

entries.source:
Spin around, extending your weapon in radius %d and damaging all targets around you for %d%% weapon damage.
		At level 3 all damage done will also make the targets bleed for an additional %d%% damage over 5 turns
entries.target:
原地旋转，伸展你的武器，伤害你周围半径 %d 范围内的所有目标，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		等级 3 时，所造成的伤害会引发额外 %d%% 流血伤害，持续 5 回合。

entries.source:
Coats your stone spikes with insidious poison, dealing %0.1f total nature damage over 6 turns while reducing all healing by %d%%.
		The damage increases with Spellpower and the chance to poison and healing reduction increases with either Spellpower or Physical Power, whichever is greater.
entries.target:
用毒素覆盖岩石尖刺，使生物中毒 6 回合，造成合计 %0.1f 自然伤害，并减少 %d%% 治疗效果。
		伤害受法术强度加成；中毒的施加几率和治疗效果降低幅度受法术强度和物理强度中较高者加成。

entries.source: When attach to an other item:
A shifting, writhing, snake-like dragon, blinking in and out of existence, just waiting for you to turn your back.
entries.target: 一只不断闪烁和换位的蛇状巨龙，它只是在等你回头。

entries.source: Remember though that dying is an integral part of the game and helps you become a better player.
entries.target: 请记住死也是游戏不可或缺的一部分，这可以帮助你成为一个更好的玩家。

entries.source: Which weapon will be your sentry?
entries.target: 选择哪把武器作为诅咒护卫？

entries.source:
At the start of each turn, if you're bleeding, you gain %d hate.

You can activate this talent to use your own life for power, bleeding yourself for a small portion of your maximum life (%0.2f damage) over the next 5 turns. This bleed cannot be resisted or removed, but can be reduced by Bloodstained.
entries.target:
每回合开始时，如果你正在流血，你获得 %d 仇恨。

你可以主动使用此技能，使用你的生命值换取力量，使你在5回合里受到最大生命值一小部分的流血伤害（%0.2f 伤害）。此流血效果不能被抵抗，无法被移除，但可以被血染系技能减少。

entries.source: I have found a strange staff in my travels (#LIGHT_GREEN#*describe it in detail*#LAST#)  It looked very old and very powerful. I dared not use it.
entries.target: 我在旅途中找到了一根奇怪的法杖（#LIGHT_GREEN#*详细描述它的外观*#LAST#）。它看起来非常古老且威力强大，我不敢使用它。

entries.source: These dark spellcasters extinguish life, twist death, and raise armies of undead monsters to sate their lust for power and pursue their ultimate goal: Eternal life.
entries.target: 这些黑暗的施法者泯灭生命、扭曲死亡、召唤不死亡灵作为他们的军队来满足他们对力量的渴求，并追求他们的终极目标：永恒的生命。

entries.source: %s raises %s %s, and a red light flashes from it's eye sockets!
entries.target: %s 令 %s %s站了起来，一道红光从它眼中闪过！

entries.source: Why do I understand you? The texts are unreadable to me.
entries.target: 为什么我能听懂你的话？那些文字我根本看不懂。

entries.source: Caught the attention of overpowered greater multi-hued wyrms in Vor Armoury. Perhaps fleeing is in order.
entries.target: 在沃尔的军械库引起了超强的远古七彩巨龙的注意。也许，离开是最好的主意。

entries.source:
#{bold}#
Here lies Mara
#{normal}#70 - 109#{italic}#
You knew your doom
And faced it
Rest in peace
#{normal}#
entries.target:
#{bold}#
这里躺着玛拉
#{normal}#70 - 109#{italic}#
你已预见自己的末日
并面对了它
安息吧
#{normal}#

entries.source: This azure ring seems to be always moist to the touch.
entries.target: 这个海蓝色的戒指看上去总是水汪汪的。

entries.source: inflicts either shocked or wet, chosen at random
entries.target: 随机造成震撼或浸湿效果。

entries.source:
You can throw knives with lightning speed, increasing your attack speed with them by %d%% and giving you a %d%% chance when striking a target in melee to throw a knife at a random foe within 7 tiles for 100%% damage. 
		This bonus attack can only trigger once per turn, and does not trigger from throwing knife attacks.
entries.target:
你可以闪电般地投掷你的飞刀。增加 %d%% 攻击速度，近战攻击时有 %d%% 几率投掷一把飞刀随机对 7 格范围内的一名敌人造成 100%% 伤害。
		每回合仅触发 1 次，不会被投掷飞刀触发。
向下通往瓦砾之中的楼梯。

entries.source: An object resolver interprets additional filter fields to generate an object and determine where it will go.
entries.target: 物品解析器解释附加的过滤字段以生成物品，并决定它将被放入何处。

entries.source: release a burst of light and dark damage (scales with Magic)
entries.target: 爆发光明和黑暗伤害（受魔法值加成）

entries.source: #VIOLET#As %s falls you notice a portal appearing.
entries.target: #VIOLET#当 %s 倒下时你注意到一个传送门出现了。
